# dsh-network-settings 2.0.0
User-Agent rewriting, HTTP / CONNECT / SOCKS5 proxying, and request retries for dsh. Requires **dsh-
loader ^2.0.0** and **Node.js >=24.9.0**.
The loader renders a declarative template as one collapsed Network card with User-Agent, proxy, and
retry groups. Save, cancel, and restore-defaults apply to the whole card. Saved changes affect the n
ext outgoing request.
Before `0.1.6-alpha.2`, open Settings → Plugin configuration. On newer versions, open this plugin's
detail page. Configuration lives at `<profile>/config/dsh-network-settings/config.json`; password va
lues stay opaque in browser responses and revision conflicts preserve drafts.
The proxy supports authentication, NO_PROXY, timeouts, redirects and compressed responses. Retries c
over network failures and 429/500/502/503/504; cancellation and non-replayable streams are never ret
ried. Unload releases this plugin's fetch layer while preserving later wrappers.
The old custom UI and settings write route have been removed. Composition values and the legacy `$DS
H_HOME/net-proxy.json` seed defaults; saved profile configuration takes precedence. Old settings nam
espaces are not moved automatically. Record custom namespace values before upgrading and save them t
hrough the new form.
The authenticated `/_dsh/dsh-network-settings/probe` endpoint remains available (GET health check, P
OST connectivity probe). Declarative templates have no custom action button, so this version does no
t include the old custom Test Connection button.
The local development dependency points at the adjacent `../dsh-loader` 2.0 workspace. Build it firs
t, then run `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm pack --dry-r
un `npm install --legacy-peer-deps`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm pack --dry-run` here.
See 中文说明 and the real launch verification record. The latter documents the upstream dependency pin r
equired by `0.1.6-alpha.1`.
